label: Arundel collection begun
summary: A dated note says the collection was begun in Florence in the house of Piero di Braccio Martelli.

claims.statement: A note in the Codex Arundel states that the collection was begun in Florence in the house of Piero di Braccio Martelli on 22 March 1508.

sources.cite: Discovering da Vinci, Codex Arundel (popular site).

timeline.text: A dated note says the collection was begun in Florence in the house of Piero di Braccio Martelli.
timeline.basis: Autograph dated note, Codex Arundel (folio to locate).
